# MARS 980 STORM PCIe Gen5 x4 M.2 2280 Solid State Drive

## MARS 980 STORM

Dual-Cool, Full Boost

## The PCIe 5.0 Thermal Buff - Dual-System Cooling

The first PCIe 5.0 SSD with liquid and fan dual-cooling, built for zero-lag data transfer and stable performance. Compliant with NVMe 2.0, optimized for AI workloads, and supports the latest Intel and AMD platforms—leaving its mark on the performance race.

 

## Game Time, Always Ahead

The MARS 980 STORM features a sequential read/write speed of 14,000/13,000MB per second, which is double the performance of PCIe Gen4 SSDs and 8x faster than standard Gen3 SSDs. It is fully backward compatible with PCIe 4.0 and 3.0 platforms. Complete every challenge in mere seconds!

 

## Patented Design, Extreme Cooling Power

No more lag! The MARS 980 STORM features an exclusive dual-cooling design with liquid cooling and dual-fan airflow¹. Thermal liquid capacity, combined with copper heatpipes, increases heat dissipation surface area, while twin fans generate strong airflow to remove heat efficiently.

Our patented Active Cooling System delivers up to 20% lower temperatures compared to fanless heatsinks². Get stable, high-speed performance even during long sessions—this is cooling redefined.

¹The heatsink is pre-installed. Please ensure your system has sufficient space before installation. If your motherboard includes a pre-mounted M.2 heatsink, please remove it before installing this product. Refer to your motherboard manual for instructions.

²Cooling performance is based on internal lab test conditions. Actual results may vary depending on system configuration and environment.

³Disassembling this product may void warranty and affect functionality.

 

## Do More with Less Hassle

Cable management is annoying and complicated installations are such a headache! The MARS 980 STORM's built-in fan does not require an additional power cable and the SSD is ready to use as soon as it is plugged into the M.2 slot. Simplifying complexity is the best solution.

 

## Attention! Large Capacity Incoming!

Carefully selected 232-layer 3D NAND flash memory allows the MARS 980 STORM to feature an ultra-large capacity of up to 2TB, and the SSD uses a variety of data protection and error correction technologies to greatly improve TBW (Total Bytes Written) and durability to meet high load requirements.

 

## Beyond Elite

MARS 980 STORM utilizes a SLC cache algorithm and DRAM Cache Buffer technology to take advantage of caching and adopts LDPC (Low Density Parity Check Code) error correction mechanism to ensure the accuracy of data transmission and file security.

 

## SSD Toolbox value-added software for real-time status monitoring

SSD Toolbox ensures users utilize the latest Firmware version for the best performance and employs Self-Monitoring, Analysis and Reporting Technology (S.M.A.R.T.) to understand the health and remaining lifespan of SSDs, as well as the current operating temperature and storage capacity, so that users can track of SSD status at any time.
